description: Fix UX bugs: agent_paused SSE event missing, Skip button dead link, CLI old stage names, missing server guard

tasks.title: Add agent_paused to SSE ALL_EVENT_TYPES
tasks.description: Add 'agent_paused' to the ALL_EVENT_TYPES array in api/events.ts. The EventBus already emits this event from AgentRunnerService, but SSE doesn't forward it.
acceptanceCriteria: api/events.ts ALL_EVENT_TYPES includes 'agent_paused'
SSE client receives event: agent_paused when agent pauses at gate
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: One-line fix. Just add the string to the array.

tasks.title: Register agent_paused in Web UI SSE hook and types
tasks.description: Add agent_paused event type to web/src/lib/types.ts SSEEvent union. Register agent_paused handler in useSSE.ts that invalidates issue queries (invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['issues'] }) and specific issue query).
acceptanceCriteria: web/src/lib/types.ts includes agent_paused in SSEEvent type
useSSE.ts handles agent_paused event and triggers query invalidation
When agent pauses, issue detail page automatically shows approval panel without manual refresh
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Follow the same pattern as existing event handlers in useSSE.ts. The invalidation key should match what useQueries.ts uses.

tasks.title: Remove dead Skip button from IssueDetailPage
tasks.description: Remove the Skip button from the approval panel in IssueDetailPage.tsx. There's no backend API for reject/skip, so the button is misleading.
acceptanceCriteria: No Skip button rendered in the approval panel
Only 'Approve & Continue' button is shown
Web UI build passes
tasks.notes: Simple removal. If the button has surrounding layout (flex container etc.), adjust as needed so the Approve button still looks good.

tasks.title: Update CLI formatStage to use current stage names
tasks.description: Update formatStage() in cli/commands/issue.ts to use plan/build/check instead of designing/implementing. Also check for any other hardcoded old stage names in CLI code.
acceptanceCriteria: formatStage() returns 'plan' for Stage.Plan, 'build' for Stage.Build, 'check' for Stage.Check
No references to 'designing' or 'implementing' in CLI code
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Search for 'designing' and 'implementing' across cli/ directory to catch all occurrences.

tasks.title: Add requireServer guard to CLI commands
tasks.description: Import and call requireServer() at the entry of each CLI command handler in issue.ts, project.ts, and quick.ts. Do NOT add it to server commands or init command.
acceptanceCriteria: mo issue list shows friendly error when server is not running
mo project list shows friendly error when server is not running
mo server start still works without requireServer check
mo init still works without requireServer check
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: requireServer is already defined in cli/index.ts:30. Just import and call it in the action handlers. Be careful about the import path.

tasks.title: Verify build and manual test
tasks.description: Run full build (npm run build in packages/cli, npm run build in packages/cli/web), run typecheck, verify all fixes work.
acceptanceCriteria: npm run build succeeds in packages/cli
Web UI build succeeds
Typecheck passes
Manual test: start server, create issue, start agent, verify approval panel appears automatically
